note: Commissioner-confirmed: draft and all transfers are performed on Sports.ru using Sports.ru positions, prices and accounting; rosters and transfers are then mirrored on Yahoo. Yahoo eligibility cannot expand Sports.ru roster slots. Cap 20000. At most two players of one NBA club (Sports.ru rules page, checked 2026-10-19).

weeks.note: Monday-Sunday by US game day per the rules page; Moscow-dated calendar shows Tuesday-Monday. Pre-season transfers are not counted.

fblTransfers.source: League owner, 2026-10-20: the FBL limit is 3 transfers a week, Monday to Sunday; the first week ends on Sunday 25.10. Pre-season transfers are free (see preseason).

hours.source: League owner, 2026-10-20: transfers are allowed strictly from 08:00 to 22:00 Moscow time.
hours.note: Sports.ru journals give only the date; the time is bounded by the watcher: after its last read of the journal without the transfer (seenAfter) and by its first read with it (seenAt).

fblTransfers.preseason: League owner, 2026-10-20: pre-season transfers are unlimited and free. Sports.ru's own deadline of the first round (20.10, 21:30 Moscow time, the team page's «Дедлайн») ends the pre-season: a transfer counts against the FBL week when the watcher saw it at or after countFrom (or, never timed, when dated after that day).

whiteRule.definition: At least one player per roster who counts for the «белое правило»; a player counts by his father. The league decides who counts: the list is data/fbl-league.json "white" (league log action "white"); the app does not classify players itself.

lawyer.name: Зак Онн
lawyer.role: юрист лиги FBL: разбирает нарушения регламента
lawyer.note: His Telegram username is kept only encrypted (data/telegram-handles.enc.json, key in the LEAGUE_HANDLES_KEY secret); the league feed tags him on every breach and check.

commissioner.note: Tagged with the lawyer on every breach and check; the username is kept only encrypted (data/telegram-handles.enc.json).

leagueFeed.note: The league chat gets protocols only for transfers the watcher saw from this moment on (league owner, 20.10: no protocols for the transfers made before the bot joined the chat). Protocol numbers count from here.
leagueFeed.maxAgeNote: A deal the feed did not post within this many minutes of the watcher seeing it (an outage, an update) is not posted late to the league chat: it is recorded as reported and listed in the run log (league owner, 20.10: no late posts after an update).

managers.source: League owner, 2026-10-20: the Telegram username of each team's general manager (team index as in src/teams.js), kept only encrypted in data/telegram-handles.enc.json.
managers.note: The league feed tags the team's GM on a breach or a check of its roster.

watchlist.reason: Два нарушения до начала сезона: белое правило на драфте (18.10) и трансфер после 22:00 МСК (19.10). Лига простила, Зак Онн взял команду под прицел.

sharedPlayers.source: League owner, 2026-10-20: a player may be on only one FBL team; buying a player another FBL team holds is a direct breach (Sports.ru itself allows it).
sharedPlayers.note: The team that bought him later is in breach; the team that had him first is not.
sharedPlayers.scoringRule: His points go only to the FBL team that held him first; the later buyer's slot scores 0 for those games until the breach is repaired. When the first holder cannot be told (purchases inside one watcher window, firstHolder in src/rules.js), both teams keep his points and the case is under the lawyer's check.

scoringFormula.formula: Yahoo league settings: PTS+REB+AST+ST+BLK+FGM-FGA+FTM-FTA-2*TO-PF, plus 1 per game played (GP)
scoringFormula.reason: The league scores on Yahoo, which cannot award points for team wins or take them for losses.
scoringFormula.gamePoints: The formula on each played game's own box score: the columns of Sports.ru's game table (pointsSource BOX), or ESPN's box score for games of the last two US days (source ESPN). A row without readable box columns has no FBL points (NO_BOX). Sports.ru's ФО stays as sportsPoints and is never FBL points.
scoringFormula.participationRule: +1 for every game played (Yahoo GP), whatever the minutes
scoringFormula.participationDecidedBy: league owner, 2026-10-21 (Yahoo league settings screenshot; replaces the exact-minutes rule recorded the same morning)
scoringFormula.participationNote: Sports.ru's own formula gives +2 for 10:00 or more minutes and +1 below, plus its result bonus; its season totals, prices and per-game points keep that rule, so they are compared after removing both.

forecastBasis.note: For a player ESPN projects, points per game and games are each the equal-weight mean of ESPN's projection and the model's, as first documented in docs/ACCEPTANCE.md. Neither ESPN's games nor the mean are validated (no archive of past ESPN projections); the weight is to be fitted on 2026/27 with the frozen snapshot data/forecast-snapshots/2026-27/2026-10-17.json.

objective.note: Transfer advice keeps maximising expected FBL points; the standings add, for every team, Monte Carlo probabilities of 1st place and of a top-3 finish.

yahoo.role: Scoring and standings of the league (Sports.ru: draft, transfers, prices and accounting)
yahoo.source: League settings screenshots from the league owner
yahoo.scoringType: Season Points (commissioner, 22.10.2026: fantasy points by the league weights, not category totals)
yahoo.slotFit: Not checked: a Sports.ru-legal roster is not tested against these ten slots under Yahoo eligibility (Yahoo positions are analyst-published, not read from the platform; 21.10 every FBL roster fits).
